title: Abyssals v0.90.49 — Clearer Moves
notes: Animation frames rebuilt from original detailed sources at 192x192 instead of 64x64, at the same screen size, plus 35% longer animation timing make anticipation, contact and aftermath easier to follow. Fixes the town leader freeze after attacks such as Avalon Cleave: animation anchors now find the player health panel inside the leader portrait layout. Both attack directions, all eight leaders and Full/Reduced motion are covered by live browser regression tests. Original Mercy artwork and timing, existing saves, quests, permanent deaths, package and original signing certificate are preserved.
